<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Instrument+Serif:ital@0;1&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--ql-bg:#080b12;--ql-fg:#e2e5eb;--ql-gold:#c4a44a;--ql-gold-bright:#d4ba6a;--ql-gold-dim:#9a7d3f;--ql-navy:#101725;--ql-navy-mid:#1a2438;--ql-void:#080b12;--ql-muted:#8a8f9b;--ql-card-bg:rgba(255,255,255,0.02);--ql-border:rgba(196,164,74,0.12)}
body,.body-container,.content-wrapper,.body-wrapper{background-color:var(--ql-bg)!important;color:var(--ql-fg)!important;font-family:'DM Sans',-apple-system,sans-serif!important}
h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,.hs_cos_wrapper h1,.hs_cos_wrapper h2,.hs_cos_wrapper h3{font-family:'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif!important;color:var(--ql-fg)!important;letter-spacing:-0.03em!important}
p,li,span,div,a,td{font-family:'DM Sans',-apple-system,sans-serif!important}
p,li,.hs_cos_wrapper p{color:var(--ql-muted)!important}
em,i{color:var(--ql-gold)!important}
a{color:var(--ql-gold)!important}a:hover{color:var(--ql-gold-bright)!important}
.dnd-section{background-color:var(--ql-bg)!important;background-image:none!important}
.dnd-section+.dnd-section{border-top:1px solid rgba(196,164,74,0.1)!important}
.header-container,.header-container-inner,header,.navigation-primary{background-color:var(--ql-bg)!important;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ql-border)!important}
.header-container a,.hs-menu-wrapper a,.navigation-primary a{color:var(--ql-muted)!important;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif!important;font-size:14px!important}
.header-container a:hover,.hs-menu-wrapper a:hover{color:var(--ql-gold)!important}
/* Navigation dropdown styling */
.hs-menu-wrapper .hs-menu-children-wrapper,.navigation-primary .hs-menu-children-wrapper,.header-container .hs-menu-children-wrapper,ul.hs-menu-children-wrapper{background-color:#101725!important;border:1px solid rgba(196,164,74,0.15)!important;border-radius:8px!important;padding:8px 0!important;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)!important}
.hs-menu-children-wrapper a,.hs-menu-children-wrapper li a{color:#e2e5eb!important;padding:8px 20px!important;font-size:14px!important}
.hs-menu-children-wrapper a:hover,.hs-menu-children-wrapper li a:hover{color:#c4a44a!important;background-color:rgba(196,164,74,0.08)!important}

.hs-button,.cta_button,a.cta_button,.hs-cta-wrapper a,.hs-cta-node a,button.hs-button,input.hs-button,.primary-cta .btn,.primary-cta a{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f0dca0,#c9a961 40%,#9a7d3f)!important;color:#080b12!important;border:none!important;border-radius:8px!important;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif!important;font-weight:600!important;padding:12px 32px!important;text-decoration:none!important}
.kl-card,.card,.featured-card,[class*="card"]{background:var(--ql-card-bg)!important;border:1px solid var(--ql-border)!important;border-radius:12px!important;color:var(--ql-fg)!important}
.testimonial,[class*="testimonial"]{background:var(--ql-card-bg)!important;border:1px solid var(--ql-border)!important;border-radius:12px!important}
.hs_cos_wrapper img{border-radius:12px}
.hs-form input,.hs-form textarea,.hs-form select{background:var(--ql-navy)!important;border:1px solid var(--ql-border)!important;color:var(--ql-fg)!important;border-radius:8px!important}
.hs-form label{color:var(--ql-muted)!important}
.dnd-section:first-child{background:var(--ql-bg)!important;position:relative}
.dnd-section:first-child::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top right,rgba(196,164,74,0.08),transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
body::after{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;opacity:0.02;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noise'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noise)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
/* Remove white backgrounds from images on dark theme */
.blend-multiply img,img.blend-multiply{mix-blend-mode:multiply}
.no-blend,.no-blend img{mix-blend-mode:normal!important}
@media(max-width:767px){h1{font-size:2.5rem!important}h2{font-size:1.75rem!important}}










</style>
